issues.description: The template's Bitmap24 class header declares save(const std::string&) as returning int, but the Bitmap24::save implementation in the template returns void (no return value). The solution repository uses a void return for save in the header. This mismatch between the declaration and implementation in the template will lead to compilation/type conflicts for students and is unlikely to be an intentional pedagogical gap.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template header's save declaration match the implementation and the solution: change the declaration in example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp from 'int save(const std::string &i_filename);' to 'void save(const std::string &i_filename);' or alternatively make the implementation return an int consistently. The recommended fix is to use 'void' to match the implementation in Bitmap24.cpp and the solution.
